Help [[Devona]] to defeat [[Maz Scourgeheart]] in the [[Forsaken Tunnels]] [[dungeon]] before his [[elemental]] army overwhelms [[Ascalon]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Enter the tunnels and rendezvous with Devona. ''(first time only)''
* Enter the tunnels. ''(when repeating the quest)''
* Secure the [[Dungeon Key|key]] and and {{sic}} gain access to the lower level.
* Find a way through the crystal gate.
* Defeat [[Maz Scourgeheart]].
* Exit the tunnels and report to '''Devona''' in Piken Square.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* Devona joins your party (first time only)
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==

{{Bug|The map in the Northlands points you towards the eastern entrance, but the western entrance is actually closer to Piken Square. Moreover, Artificer Mullenix is immediately present after going through the western entrance, making it likely the intended one.}}

Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map). If a player has not completed [[Long Thought Forgotten]], this entrance will be closed, forcing you to go to the eastern entrance.

If any member of the party is doing the quest for the first time, Devona will join you as a level 5 ally, and the enemies you face will be similar to those found during [[Long Thought Forgotten]] and [[Charr in the Tunnels]]. Devona has a high damage output for her level, but she is not very durable against the enemies in the dungeon. Fortunately, if she is killed, she will resurrect herself as soon as no foes are within [[earshot]].

On repeated visits to the tunnels, you will have to deal with additional Charr foes whose levels scale with that of the lowest-leveled member of the party, up to a maximum of level 18. It is advisable to bring Devona as a hero so that you can make use of skills unlocked outside [[Pre-Searing Ascalon]].

;Level 1
This part of the quest is the same as [[Charr in the Tunnels]], except that the inhabitants of [[Wyle Brimscourge]]'s chamber may be slightly more numerous, and you will have to deal with the more powerful Charr on repeat visits. Fight your way down to the south end of the dungeon as usual, [[pull]] Wyle Brimscourge and kill him for the [[Dungeon Key]], then run or fight your way to the [[Dungeon Lock]] and the portal to level 2.

;Level 2
Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during [[Charr in the Tunnels]], but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some [[Shard Elemental]]s, unless the nearby [[Ironheart]] has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the [[Elemental Crystal]] [[bundle]] they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.

;Level 3
You start at the middle of the south side of this floor, and will need to follow the purple path on the map to the right. Head northeast until you reach a large chamber filled with ruins and Charr, then hug the left wall heading north until you can start heading west again. Pass under the bridge, being careful of any Charr above. Just after the bridge, you may want to take a short detour south to clear out the Charr atop another bridge you will be passing under later. Continue west and you will reach a large foundry area, where your goal is to reach one of the stairways leading up to the higher walkways to the southwest. There is a resurrection shrine nearby, and from there you should be able to see the [[Boss Key]] lying on the overlook further south. After picking up the key, return to the red path on the map to the right, and fight your way around to the [[Boss Lock]], then to the large open area to the southwest where [[Maz Scourgeheart]] and his elementals await you.

====Maz Scourgeheart====
The [[elementalist]] [[boss]] is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the [[Elemental Keystone]] one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.

Maz will start with [[Fire Magic]], including [[Mark of Rodgort]], [[Fireball]] and [[Lava Font]]. After teleporting once, he will switch to [[Air Magic]], with [[Lightning Javelin]] and [[Whirlwind]] to interrupt attackers and [[Lightning Strike]] to hit without [[line of sight]]. For the last confrontation he will use [[Water Magic]], [[snare|snaring]] his enemies with [[Deep Freeze]] and [[Shard Storm]] while protecting himself with [[Blurred Vision]] and [[Swirling Aura]]. In all three fights, he will also use [[Earthquake]] for AoE [[knock down|knockdown]] and [[Kinetic Armor]] to increase his [[armor rating]].

His elementals are identical to the other elementals in the dungeon, and behave as a group. While they can deal significant melee damage at low levels, sufficient [[AoE]] damage should dispatch them quickly.

Maz and his minions shouldn't pose too much of a threat compared to the other mobs in the dungeon, especially if you are a spellcaster with high firepower. His spells are also slow to cast, giving you a generous window to spike him down before he becomes a problem. [[Armor-ignoring damage]] in particular bypasses [[Kinetic Armor]], and [[Backfire]] will shut him down completely. Should you still face difficulties, equipping Devona with [[interrupt]]s and/or [[enchantment removal]] can counter most of Maz's tactics.

Upon his death, [[Maz's Chest]] will spawn. After every player in the party has opened the chest, a countdown will start and the party will be returned to Piken Square.

Talk to Devona to finish the quest.

==Notes==
* Although this quest can be acquired without {{reforgedmode}} enabled, the quest NPCs will not spawn and the objectives will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.
** Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of [[the Northlands]], making it slightly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
* When repeating the quest, there will be additional Charr groups throughout the dungeon with no loot and levels that scale with the weakest member of the party. Players interested in [[speed clear]]s and safer runs may therefore prefer to abandon the quest after opening the reward chest, though this means never unlocking Devona as a [[hero]].
** An alternative is to join a party with another player who is doing the first-time version of the quest, or with a player whose level is lower than 10.
* The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge and the Elemental Crystal on level 2, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten or [[Charr in the Tunnels]] active in their quest log.
** If another player in the party has Charr in the Tunnels active, the party can complete that quest by killing all of the [[Charr Patrol Stalker]]s, then use the portal back to level 1 to reset the map, enabling access to level 3 without returning to the surface. This makes the run slightly longer, but allows the party to kill three additional charr bosses along the way.
* It is possible to kill Maz Scourgeheart by dealing damage at range (typically with spells such as [[Fire Storm]] or [[Symbol of Wrath]] or a bow with long enough range) without opening any crystal gate. 
* Once Maz is killed, the remaining Shard Elementals of the second wave (with the exception of the one carrying the Elemental Keystone) will have a special animation and stop attacking the players. They won't retaliate even when attacked.

==Trivia==
* This quest was added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401|April 1st, 2026]] update.
* This quest is actually coded as two quests, one for the first time and one for repeated runs.
